page_title: PAR 2-1 VER | Parma v Verona 15/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+7' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Verona comes to nothing.
90+6' The ball goes out for a corner. Parma can continue in their attacking effort.
90+4' The substitution is prepared. Christian Ordonez (Parma) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Gabriel Strefezza.
90+3' 2 - 1 Goal! Hans Nicolussi Caviglia plays a hopeful cross into a crowded box. Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) times his jump perfectly and sends a header inside the left post from close in. 2:1.
90+2' Some great controlled play and passing from Parma. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' The referee blows his whistle, Parma are awarded a corner kick.
90' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Parma) takes the corner which is cleared. The ball is out of play and Parma manage to earn a corner.
89' We can have a look at the statistics now, particularly the total attempts – 24:3.
86' Luca Pairetto shows a yellow card to Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Verona) for his blatant foul.
86' Parma force their opponents to concede a corner.

85' Edoardo Corvi (Parma) beats his marker and unleashes a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box. Lorenzo Montipo sees the ball late but does well to stop it going into the bottom right corner. Parma win a corner.
84' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Lorenzo Montipo, who smothers the ball.
82' Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
80' Parma take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
79' Paolo Sammarco has decided to substitute Cheikh Niasse and he is replaced by Suat Serdar (Verona).
79' Abdou Harroui comes off the pitch to be replaced by Tobias Slotsager (Verona).
76' One of the Parma players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
75' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Parma) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
74' Abdou Harroui (Verona) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Luca Pairetto who sees an offensive foul.
72' Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Lorenzo Montipo.
71' Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort crashes against the crossbar.
70' Here is a change. Oliver Sorensen is going off and Carlos Cuesta gives the last tactical orders to Gaetano Oristanio (Parma).
69' Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) misses a rebound from close range. His effort floats narrowly over the crossbar!
69' Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Parma) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
67' Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
66' Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Verona) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
65' Enrico Delprato (Parma) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Luca Pairetto saw the whole situation.
62' Paolo Sammarco has decided to make a change. Amin Sarr (Verona) replaces Kieron Bowie.
62' Here's the change. Mandela Keita leaves the pitch and Hans Nicolussi Caviglia (Parma) comes on as a substitute.
62' A short pass finds Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) in acres of space on the edge of the box and he decides to go for glory. His efforts looks in for all the world but just creeps past the left post.
60' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Al Musrati (Verona) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
59' Some patient build-up play from Parma as they look to unlock the defence.
57' The linesman referee is pointing towards the corner flag. It will be a corner kick.
57' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball. The referee points to the corner flag and Parma will take a corner.
54' Al Musrati (Verona) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Luca Pairetto blows for a foul. That's a free kick to Parma.
54' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
53' Armel Bella-Kotchap (Verona) receives a precise pass and threatens the keeper with a long-range shot. His attempt goes miles wide of the left post.
52' Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) whips in a cross from the corner, but Lorenzo Montipo is well positioned and punches the ball away.
51' 74:26 – this is the current ball possession ratio.
51' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Verona for a penalty. Play continues.
48' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Verona is cautioned for aggressive play.
46' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jacob Ondrejka (Parma) will replace Lautaro Valenti.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+4' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Lautaro Valenti (Parma) sees a yellow card from Luca Pairetto after he sent one of the opposing players to the ground.
45+1' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
43' 1 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Abdou Harroui (Verona) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Edoardo Corvi no chance!
43' Abdou Harroui (Verona) is going to take the penalty!

42' Alessandro Circati (Parma) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for an infringement. Verona have been awarded a penalty kick!
41' The foul by Alessandro Circati (Parma) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Luca Pairetto.
39' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
38' Mateo Pellegrino (Parma) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post.
37' Sascha Britschgi (Parma) tries to find the head of a teammate in the box but overhits the cross.
35' Enrico Delprato (Parma) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.

32' Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the middle of the goal. Lorenzo Montipo is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save.
32' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.

32' A through ball from Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) fails to reach Sascha Britschgi as one of the defending players reacts brilliantly to intercept the effort. If the pass had been produced a little bit earlier, Sascha Britschgi could have got into a promising position. Parma will take a corner kick.
30' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) receives the ball from the set piece on the edge of the box, but fails to score because his shot is blocked.
30' Kieron Bowie (Verona) commits a rough challenge and Luca Pairetto blows his whistle for a foul. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Parma.
29' It's a free kick to Parma, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
27' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Gabriel Strefezza (Parma), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
26' The corner from Gabriel Strefezza (Parma) is cleared away by the defence.
25' Verona string together a series of short passes.
24' Emanuele Valeri (Parma) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.

21' Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards to the bottom left corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Lorenzo Montipo pulls off an easy save.
20' Substitution. Rafik Belghali leaves the pitch and is replaced by Jean-Daniel Akpa Akpro (Verona).
18' Rafik Belghali (Verona) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
18' Rafik Belghali (Verona) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
17' The referee blows his whistle as Armel Bella-Kotchap (Verona) was too aggressive in his challenge.
11' We have witnessed a sending off. Gift Orban (Verona) is shown a red card and it's an early bath for him I guess.
10' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Sascha Britschgi (Parma) but poses no threat.
7' A player from Parma pulled an opponent down, forcing the referee to blow his whistle.

4' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Mandela Keita has a shot blocked, but the ball rebounds outside the box to Adrian Bernabe Garcia (Parma) and he blasts it into the bottom right corner, giving the goalkeeper no chance. The score is 1:0.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Verona will kick the game off.
